sources.text: NPCI/UPI/OC-226A/2026-27 — 03rd July 2026 To, All UPI Member Issuer Banks, PSP Banks and UPI Applications Dear Sir/Madam, **Subject: Enhancement of Transaction Limit for On-Device Biometric Authentication in UPI** Reference is drawn to NPCI circular NPCI/UPI/OC-226/2025-26 dated 07th October 2025, wherein On-Device Biometric Authentication (Fingerprint, Face, etc) was introduced as an additional option for authentication in lieu of UPI PIN. In view of increasing adoption in the ecosystem, it has been decided to revise the per-transaction limit for On-Device Biometric Authentication (fingerprint, face, etc.) in UPI is hereby enhanced from ₹5,000 to ₹10,000, effective 07th August 2026. Issuer Banks, PSP Banks and UPI Applications to ensure adequate customer communication regarding the updated limit. All existing validations, compliance requirements, specifications, and regulatory guidelines shall continue to remain fully applicable, and participants are required to ensure adherence. Yours faithfully, SD/- Sourabh Tomar Deputy Chief UPI Product

sources.text: NPEL NATIONAL PAYMENTS CORPORATION OF INDIA Circular:NPCI/2021-22/BAP/001 1st February, 2022 To, All Members of the Aadhaar Enabled Payment System (AePS). Subject: Standardization in McC (Merchant category codes)for BHiM Aadhaar Pay Dear Sir/Madam, BHiM Aadhaar Pay(BAP) allows merchants to accept digital payments from customers using the Aadhaar biometric authentication. As per the current implementation of BHIM Aadhar Pay by the members, acquiring banks send MCC in the BHIM Aadhaar Pay online transaction request. However, the MCC value is set to a default value of ‘6012' for all merchants, thereby creating considerable difficuity in classifying merchants into specific categories based on the type of business OR trade or services supplied by the merchants. In order to ease the process of classifying merchants and tracking BHIM Aadhar Pay transactions, all the members are advised to ensure that the appropriate MCc is passed in the online transaction request as per the specifications defined by Iso (International Organisation for Standardization). All members are advised to implement the above instructions of sending the appropriate MCC for BHIM Aadhar Pay in online request to AePS (NPCI) latest by 28th February 2022. sources.text: NPCI/2023-24/RuPay/003 16th May 2023 To, All Member Banks-RuPay Dear Sir/Madam, Subject: Enabling Mail order/Telephone Order (MOTO) for RuPay-DFS Cards Internationally RuPay Global cards are accepted internationally and NPCI strives to make RuPay cardholders payment experience convenient and seamless. In the matter, we refer to NPCI circular vide: NPCI/2020-21/RuPay/033 dated 2nd Sept’2020, wherein the approach for issuers to enable MOTO transactions were provided. RuPay-DFS cardholders who make transactions on such merchants who support MOTO transactions, would be able to execute the transactions successfully once issuers enable them. We observe that issuers are yet to enable MOTO transactions at their end due to which some transactions are getting declined. This hampers the overall RuPay card international transaction customer experience. In view of the above, we request all the RuPay-DFS issuers to enable MOTO transactions, not beyond 31st May 2023. Bank may put necessary rules at their end to monitor the transaction performance at their end. Kindly reach out to your bank RM for any support or information you may need in this matter. Your sincerely, Sd/- Kunal Kalawatia Chief Products
